banner.host_forgotten: The saved SSH host key was removed. Connect again to review the host's key.
banner.not_connected: Not connected. Connect to a server first.
banner.projection_read_only: These documents are shown with a projection, so they cannot be edited or cloned. Clear the projection to edit them.

browser.load_failed: Could not load documents. See the message above.
browser.select_collection: Select a collection in the sidebar.

detail.no_changes: The documents have no field differences.
detail.no_document: This document does not exist on this side.
detail.title: Differences for key {key}

duplicates.hint: Choose key fields that are unique, such as an email address or a combination of fields, then check again.
duplicates.more: More values repeat than are listed here.
duplicates.none_found: No duplicate keys were found just now. The data may have changed since the comparison ran. Check the setup, then run the comparison again.
duplicates.none_on_side: No duplicate keys on this side.
duplicates.stale: The previous lookup is still finishing. You can look again once it is done.
duplicates.title: Duplicate keys

overview.counts: {different} different, {only_in_source} only in source, {only_in_target} only in target, {identical} identical
overview.progress: Scanned {source} source and {target} target documents, {differences} differences so far
overview.title: Run overview

column.included: Include this pair in the run

pairs.empty: No pairs yet. Pick a collection on each side and choose Add pair, or add all same-named collections of two databases.
pairs.no_counterpart_hint: These collections exist on one side only. Type the name to compare each with on the other side; a missing collection counts as empty. Indexes and collection options are not compared or copied.
pairs.title: Pairs

preflight.empty_both: Both collections are empty, so there is nothing to compare.
preflight.entry_needs_index: Needs an index on the {side} side
preflight.index_missing: no index on the key fields
preflight.needs_index: The {side} collection has no index on the key fields and is too large to compare without one. Create an index on the key fields, then check again.

results.identical: No differences. The two collections match under the current rules.
results.load_failed: The differences could not be loaded.
results.open_hint: Show the field differences of this document

rules.ignore_array_order_hint: Arrays with the same elements in a different order count as equal.
rules.ignore_field_order_hint: Documents whose fields are listed in a different order count as equal.
rules.numbers_equal_across_types_hint: An int, a long and a double with the same value count as equal.
rules.title: Rules

session.no_connections: Save a connection first, then come back to compare two collections.

setup.filter_invalid: The filter must be a JSON object, for example { "status": "active" }.
setup.incomplete: Pick a database and a collection on both sides.
setup.key_invalid: The key must be one or more field names separated by commas, such as _id or tenant, sku. Each name must be non-empty and listed once.
setup.reload_hint: The collection list is empty. Load it again.
setup.rules_invalid: The field list is not valid. Each name must be non-empty, have no empty path segments, and the list cannot be empty when only some fields are compared.
setup.same_collection: The source and the target are the same collection with the same filter, so there is nothing to compare. Pick another collection or connection, or change a filter.
setup.view_selected: A view cannot be compared. Pick a collection.

connections.allow_invalid_certs_ssh_warning: Warning: through an SSH tunnel this removes certificate protection on the connection between the SSH bastion and MongoDB.
connections.confirm_delete: Delete the connection "{name}" and its saved credentials? This cannot be undone.
connections.name: Name
connections.password_saved_hint: A secret is saved in the Keychain. Leave empty to keep it.
connections.saved_secret_will_clear: The saved secret will be removed when you save.
connections.ssh_key: SSH private key file (leave empty for password)
connections.title: Connections

doc.confirm_delete: Delete the document with _id {id}? This cannot be undone.

errors.auth_failed: Authentication failed. The server requires valid credentials; check the user name, password and authentication database.
errors.compare_cap_exceeded: There are more differences than can be kept in memory, so the comparison stopped. Narrow it with a filter, or compare fewer fields.
errors.compare_duplicate_key: Two documents on one side have the same key, so they cannot be matched. Choose a key that is unique, or look up which values repeat.
errors.compare_key_invalid: A key field holds a value that cannot be used as a key (for example an array). Choose a different key.
errors.compare_key_missing: A document has no value for one of the key fields. Choose key fields that every document has.
errors.compare_key_not_indexed: No index covers this key, and the collection is too large to compare without one. Create an index on the key fields and try again.
errors.compare_key_order: The documents did not arrive in the expected key order, so the comparison was stopped to avoid wrong results. This can happen with an unusual collation; please report it if it persists.
errors.compare_setup_invalid: The key or field list is not valid. Each name must be non-empty, have no empty path segments, and be listed only once. Fields can be dotted paths such as address.city.
errors.database: The database reported a problem. Check your connection and try again.
errors.invalid_document: This document is not valid. Check its fields and try again.
errors.invalid_json: This is not valid JSON. Check the syntax and try again.
errors.invalid_uri: This connection string is not valid. Check it and try again.
errors.not_found: The item could not be found. It may have been removed.
errors.secret_store: Could not access the system keychain for saved credentials.
errors.ssh: The SSH tunnel could not be established. Check the SSH settings.
errors.ssh_host_key_changed: The SSH host key has changed since it was saved. This can mean someone is intercepting the connection. If you know the key was replaced, forget the host and connect again.
errors.superseded: The connection changed while this was running, so the result was discarded.
errors.tls_through_tunnel: TLS certificate verification is not possible through an SSH tunnel. To connect you would have to enable "Allow invalid TLS certificates", which removes certificate protection on the connection between the SSH bastion and MongoDB (the SSH leg stays encrypted). Only do this on a network you trust.
errors.unauthorized: Your user is not allowed to do this on the server.
errors.unsupported: This action is not supported for the current connection.

failures.compare_check: Could not check the collections before comparing
failures.compare_collections: Could not load the collections for the comparison
failures.compare_databases: Could not load the databases for the comparison
failures.compare_detail: Could not load the document differences
failures.compare_duplicates: Could not look up the duplicate keys. Try again, or check that both connections are still reachable
failures.compare_duplicates_timeout: The lookup took longer than two minutes. Add a filter on the collections so fewer documents are searched, then try again
failures.compare_open: Could not open the comparison connections
failures.compare_rows: Could not load the list of differences
failures.delete_secrets: Could not remove the saved credentials, so the connection was kept. Try again
failures.runtime: The background worker stopped. Restart Curlybrace

forget.message: Remove the saved SSH host key for {host}:{port}? You will be asked to trust the host's key again on the next connection.
forget.title: Forget SSH host

hostkey.message: The authenticity of the SSH host {host} cannot be established. Verify the fingerprint with the host's administrator before trusting it.
hostkey.title: Unknown SSH host

persist.blocked: Saving is turned off because the saved connections file could not be backed up. Fix the permissions of the connections file or its folder, then restart Curlybrace.
persist.config_dir_unknown: Could not find a settings folder, so saved connections cannot be loaded or stored.
persist.corrupt: The saved connections file is not valid.
persist.corrupt_backed_up: The saved connections file was not readable. A backup copy was kept next to it; saving a connection will replace the original file.
persist.corrupt_backup_failed: The saved connections file was not readable and a backup copy could not be made. Saving is turned off so nothing is overwritten.
persist.invalid_path: The connections file location is not valid.
persist.read_failed: Could not read the saved connections file.
persist.skipped_backed_up: {n} saved connection(s) were invalid or from a newer version and were skipped. A backup copy of the original file was kept.
persist.skipped_backup_failed: {n} saved connection(s) were invalid or from a newer version and were skipped, and a backup copy could not be made. Saving is turned off so nothing is lost.
persist.unreadable_backed_up: The saved connections file could not be read. A backup copy was kept next to it.
persist.unreadable_backup_failed: The saved connections file could not be read or backed up. Saving is turned off so nothing is overwritten.
persist.write_failed: Could not write the saved connections file.
